## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Scientific data
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Tables, measurements, and dataset metadata
//  - Data series

//==
// # Tables, measurements, and dataset metadata
//
// Rectangular tables of typed columns, individual measurement records with
// uncertainty, and the descriptive records that identify a dataset, its sensor
// channels, and their calibration. Values carry their units explicitly via
// UnitOfMeasure rather than through the type system.

//==
// # Tables

// The typed values of a table column: exactly one element type, carried by
// the matching case.
type ColumnValues
    = Numbers(Values: Array<Number>)
    | Integers(Values: Array<Integer>)
    | Strings(Values: Array<String>)
    | Booleans(Values: Array<Boolean>)
    | Instants(Values: Array<Instant>);

// A named, typed table column. Numeric columns state their unit via the
// owning dataset's metadata or the column name.
type DataColumn
{
    Name: String;
    Values: ColumnValues;
}

// A rectangular table of typed columns. Every column's populated array has
// exactly RowCount entries.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Table_(information))
type DataTable
{
    Columns: Array<DataColumn>;
    RowCount: Integer;
}

//==
// # Measurements and metadata

// A single timestamped measurement. IValue and Uncertainty are both expressed
// in Unit; Uncertainty is one standard deviation.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Measurement_uncertainty)
type MeasurementRecord
    implements IValue
{
    Time: Instant;
    Value: Number;
    Uncertainty: Number;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}

// One key-value pair of dataset metadata (instrument id, operator, campaign).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metadata)
type MetadataEntry
    implements IValue
{
    Key: String;
    Value: String;
}

// Identifying information for a dataset: name, human-readable description,
// and open-ended metadata entries.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Data_set)
type DatasetDescriptor
{
    Name: String;
    Description: String;
    Metadata: Array<MetadataEntry>;
}

// Description of one acquisition channel of an instrument: what it measures,
// in which unit, and how often it samples.
type SensorChannel
{
    Name: String;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
    SamplePeriod: Duration;
}

// A calibration mapping from raw readings to physical values as a piecewise
// linear function. InputValues is strictly increasing and parallel to
// OutputValues; inputs are in InputUnit, outputs in OutputUnit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calibration_curve)
type CalibrationCurve
{
    InputValues: Array<Number>;
    OutputValues: Array<Number>;
    InputUnit: UnitOfMeasure;
    OutputUnit: UnitOfMeasure;
}

//==
// # Data series
//
// Named sequences of measured values: plain series, regular and irregular time
// series, vector series, event logs and labeled spans, plus the policies that
// govern resampling and missing values. Values carry their units explicitly via
// UnitOfMeasure rather than through the type system.

//==
// # Series

// A named sequence of numeric values sharing one unit: a plot trace, a sensor
// sweep, a spectrum row.
type DataSeries
{
    Name: String;
    Values: Array<Number>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}

// A uniformly sampled time series: sample i occurs at Start plus i times
// SamplePeriod. Values are in Unit.
type TimeSeries
    implements ITimeSampled
{
    Start: Instant;
    SamplePeriod: Duration;
    Values: Array<Number>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}

// A time series with explicit, strictly increasing sample times. Times and
// Values are parallel arrays; values are in Unit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unevenly_spaced_time_series)
type IrregularTimeSeries
    implements ITimeSampled
{
    Times: Array<Instant>;
    Values: Array<Number>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}

// A uniformly sampled series of 3D vectors (positions, velocities, field
// samples): sample i occurs at Start plus i times SamplePeriod. Components are
// in Unit.
type Vector3DTimeSeries
    implements ITimeSampled
{
    Start: Instant;
    SamplePeriod: Duration;
    Values: Array<Vector3D>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}
```
